target: Build a runnable demonstration of uncertainty calibration using a confidence-reliability study. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.

competency.title: Implement uncertainty calibration — distribution shift
competency.outcome: Build a runnable demonstration of uncertainty calibration using a confidence-reliability study. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.
competency.practice_task: Produce executable code or a runnable protocol grounded in a confidence-reliability study.
competency.setting_constraint: Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.
required_evidence: executable code or a runnable protocol
Include shift definition and in/out-distribution results.
Report expected calibration error and coverage with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: reporting confidence without calibration.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of uncertainty calibration.
Practice: the artifact passes a new functional case and a failure case.
Measurement: report expected calibration error and coverage against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for reporting confidence without calibration; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
